sources.entry: Trae - AI-powered IDE for coding and software development.

summary.name: TRAE
summary.one_liner: TRAE is an AI-powered IDE (code editor) for coding and software development, with a SOLO coding agent and multi-agent workspace for managing projects.
use_cases: Building complete software projects from an idea with an AI agent
Delegating coding tasks to autonomous agents
Writing and generating code snippets with AI autocompletion
Refactoring or changing parts of a codebase with AI
Comparing or replacing VS Code, Cursor or Windsurf for daily coding
Coordinating multiple AI agents across development projects
summary.what_it_does: The page describes TRAE as an AI-integrated development environment covering the full lifecycle from idea to launch. Its SOLO coding agent takes delegated tasks and is said to plan, use tools, and deliver production-ready code, while the user can see progress. A workspace brings projects and tasks together and coordinates multiple agents running in parallel. Users can use built-in agents, customize their own, and let agents act as sub-agents; the page also mentions an open ecosystem for sharing community agents. The page states codebase files are stored locally, with temporary uploads for embedding during indexing, and mentions Privacy Mode and an "ignore" function to limit data use.
notable: SOLO coding agent that plans, executes and deploys code from an idea
Multi-agent workspace with custom and sub-agents and a community agent ecosystem
Local-first privacy approach with Privacy Mode and an ignore function
caveats: Pricing and paid tiers are not stated on the page
Supported operating systems are not named in the page text (listing mentions macOS context via awesome-mac)
Testimonials on the page are promotional and unverified
